summary: FlameGuard SI is an autonomous spacecraft fire-safety, multi-sensor fusion, and mission-readiness intelligence system built by Team 2H CosmoGuard using verified data from NASA's Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) repository (BASS-II, SAME/SAME-R, FLEX/FLEX-2, SAFFIRE, and ACME CFI-G). Unlike Earth fires, microgravity (0.00g) and partial-gravity (0.16g Moon / 0.38g Mars) flames trap heat without buoyant upward drafts, while enriched lunar cabin atmospheres (30% O₂, reduced 70% N₂ thermal heat-sink) dramatically lower material ignition margins. FlameGuard SI simulates realistic 0.00g–2.00g flame physics, Limiting Oxygen Index (LOI) extinction, and cabin airflow dynamics while fusing four virtual NASA sensors (SAME/DAFT laser aerosol sizing, IR/UV cool-flame optical radiometry, surface wire thermistors, and CO pyrolysis gas sensors) to distinguish harmless 4.20 µm lunar dust from 0.18 µm smoke and execute sub-second fan cutoffs, power isolation, and FLEX fine-water-mist suppression—followed by differential OGA/WPA life-support recovery and a Phase 1 Self-Repairing Robotic Builder roadmap that protects astronauts from bone-density loss and feeds closed-loop fire-safety spin-offs back to protect Earth and Sarawak's tropical peatlands.
details:
The Space Fire Challenge & Physics Foundation

In microgravity (0.00g), hot combustion gases do not rise, forming quiet spherical diffusion flames (ACME CFI-G, PSI-159) that trap heat around electrical wiring. Furthermore, future lunar habitats operating at 10.2 psi with 30% O₂ (+42.9% oxygen enrichment) reduce cooling Nitrogen (N₂) dilution from 79% to 70%, causing flame-resistant materials like Nomex aramid (LOI: 28%) to exceed their Limiting Oxygen Index. Meanwhile, lunar regolith dust tracked into airlocks blinds conventional optical smoke detectors, causing costly false alarms.

How FlameGuard SI Works (Interactive Prototype)

  1. Physics-Accurate Multi-Gravity & Airflow Chamber (0.00g – 2.00g): Models standby cabin telemetry (24 °C room temperature with zero open flame) and dynamically renders 0.00g steady diffusion spheres, 0.16g–0.38g partial-gravity bounded zones, 1.00g buoyant teardrops, 2.00g hypergravity stretched plumes ($v \propto \sqrt{g}$), 0%–85% oxygen LOI extinction, and 0.00–0.50 m/s cabin fan airflow tilt and blow-off limits (BASS-II, PSI-25).
  2. 4-Sensor Fusion & False-Alarm Immunity (SAME / DAFT Logic): Combines laser particle sizing (0.18 µm pyrolysis smoke vs. 4.20 µm lunar dust, PSI-102), IR/UV cool-flame radiometry, surface wire thermistors, and CO pyrolysis gas telemetry.
  3. Autonomous Pre-Fire & Suppression Timeline + Differential 5s Recovery: Upon detecting wire overheating (265 °C), the SI triggers a 3-pulse caution chime, cuts ventilation airflow to 0.00 m/s within <500 ms, isolates circuit power, and discharges 1.06 kg of fine water mist / FLEX inert gas (PSI-69) when needed—then models accelerated differential recovery where high-pressure reserve/electrolysis O₂ (OGA) refills faster than closed-loop WPA water condensation.
  4. Robotic-First Construction & Earth Spin-Offs: Demonstrates why uncrewed, self-repairing robots operating in 12% low-$\text{O}_2$ fire-immune bays must build and certify habitats first—protecting astronauts from 1%–1.5% monthly microgravity bone loss—while transferring SAME-derived smoldering sensors and closed-loop recycling back to protect Earth and tropical peatlands in Sarawak, Malaysia.

Languages & Super Intelligence (SI) Attribution

  • Gemini were used to assist with code generation, physics formula verification, and structural text drafting. All SI-assisted code and visual elements are explicitly disclosed in the interface metadata and descriptive text in compliance with NASA Space Apps guidelines.
  • CapCut & Youtube was used to edit, assemble, and refine the visual assets and the 30-second elevator pitch video. Specifically, CapCut was utilized for timeline sequencing, combining live screen recordings of the flameguard.html simulation with AI-generated space-themed visuals, synchronizing voiceover narration, generating English auto-captions for accessibility, and applying visible "SI-Generated Visual" watermarks to all AI-generated video and image elements.
